diamondPolicy: We buy natural, cut and polished diamonds of any size or shape, loose or in jewelry. We do not buy laboratory-grown, uncut or rough diamonds.
gemstonePolicy: We buy only large, high-quality gemstones, including green Colombian emeralds, Burmese rubies and Ceylon blue sapphires. Certificates are welcome but not required.
